column1: # Declared coverage gaps for the nested-virtualization test suite.
# A gap is a surface we know is not covered.  It is DECLARED here, never
# inferred from a missing file, for two reasons.  A gap that is inferred
# from absence cannot tell "we have not written this" apart from "someone
# deleted it"; and a suite that simply reports fewer tests after untrue
# ones are removed reads as lost coverage rather than as honesty.
# These entries replace seventeen scripts that printed a PASS line having
# executed nothing under test.  features/efer_l2.sh was representative in

column2: if ef_unsupported; then exit 0; fi

column1: # "enumerated" is doing the load-bearing work in that sentence.  The

# was set, nothing was read, no guest ran.  Seventeen of those is not
# seventeen passing tests; it is seventeen gaps with a green light over
# them, which is strictly worse than an empty directory.
